lessons: Keep default filter configuration and exact kernel readback explicit; self-only socket failure and independent cleanup prove only that helper scope.
Emit a failing scope ID before the expected rejection if independent cleanup must be audited.
Version-tagged consumers must read actual current artifact metadata, not a stale filename; source guard refusal is evidence, not permission to relax it.
A matching registered sole Native parent must pass before any game-owned network policy action. Controlled parent fixtures are not real game sessions.
